Ethan W.: hello! day 2 and i'm trying to learn where to post stuff. quick list: badge issues, expense receipts, PTO, lunch invites, noisy CI messages. which channels for each and any etiquette to avoid spamming?

Marisol (People Ops): welcome Ethan! short map: badge/walk-in vendors -> #help (Facilities/IT triage), expenses -> #finance with the expense form link (don't paste receipts in chat), PTO -> use the PTO app or #people-ops for questions. Lunch/social -> #random or #lunch-plans.

Devon IT: CI/noisy messages -> ask us to move them into a dedicated channel like #ci-notifications. For account/hardware issues put requests in #help and tag @DevOps if urgent. Use threads for follow-ups.

Priya Eng: PR/ping etiquette: post PR links in the PR channel only if you need cross-team visibility; otherwise ping reviewers on the PR. Use reactions (:eyes:, :white_check_mark:) to acknowledge rather than posting "thanks".

Ethan W.: how do i mute channels but still get mentions?

Devon IT: channel > notification preferences > set "All new messages" off, keep "Mentions & keywords" and "Replies to threads you're in" on. For bot spam, request a dedicated channel or adjust the bot config (we can help).

onboarding-bot: Onboarding checklist: account created, training assigned, 2FA pending, laptop request pending (see https://redwood.com/internal/onboarding).

Marisol (People Ops): also pro-tip: update your timezone in profile and add your manager to #new-hires so they can answer role-specific questions. For urgent org-wide stuff use @channel sparingly.

Ethan W.: got it, thanks! i'll file badge request in #help and poll lunch in #random. joining #new-hires now :smile:
